title: Texting rules for NZ numbers
blurb: What registration you need, and how to stay within NZ anti-spam law.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings** at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Open Phone System
steps.body: Click **Phone System** in the Settings menu.

steps.title: US registration
steps.body: A2P 10DLC registration is a United States rule for US numbers. NZ Luubu Phone numbers do not need it.
steps.tip: Asked to register, or need a US or Australian number? Email hello@luubu.com.

steps.title: Get permission
steps.body: NZ law says you can only send marketing texts to people who have agreed to hear from you. Existing customers usually count.

steps.title: Say who you are
steps.body: Put your business name in every marketing text.

steps.title: Let them opt out
steps.body: Include a way to stop, like "Reply STOP to opt out". Luubu stops texting anyone who replies STOP.

steps.title: Switch on the opt-out wording
steps.body: Turn on the SMS opt-out setting in **Business Profile**. See **Turn on opt-out and unsubscribe settings**.
